basis: Actual assertions and awaited cleanup in runtime-shutdown.test.ts, reported passing in shutdown-cases-first.txt; not a separate OS process scan or provider run.

ownedChild.commandKind: process.execPath --import tsx --input-type=module -e fixed synthetic runRunner script
ownedChild.isolation: dynamic loopback URL, synthetic test token, own mkdtemp directory; minimal PATH-only child environment
ownedChild.termination: SIGKILL sent only to returned ChildProcess after real peer received claim and persisted journal was read
ownedChild.limitation: No numeric PID captured in log; ownership, kill result and close tuple are executable assertions, not reconstructed process metadata.

cleanup: Reverse-order finally cleanup kills/awaits only owned child before stopping runtimes, closes all test-server sockets/listener, then awaits recursive removal of own temp directory. Gate release and spy restoration have explicit finally paths. All10 cases passed their hooks.
globalHooks: Only test-local AbortSignal.timeout boundary and real-rename return gate; restoration recorded by passing finally paths. No product hook.
consumerChild: The original runner.test.ts SIGTERM synthetic child test also passed within its existing33; distinct from the new one SIGKILL case.
